description: Item profile and provenance (spec §5.1). validateProfile(profile) refuses an unknown key, a field object other than exactly {value, by, at, src}, a wrong type, an unknown src (local, import), kind or sensitivity, and a broken text rule (1..limit code points; no U+0000-001F, U+007F-009F, U+061C, U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+2028, U+2029, U+FEFF) or list rule (1..32 items of 1..64 code points, no comma, no duplicate) with bad_request. checkProfileProvenance(prev, next, record, {self_device_id?, prev_origins?}): prev is the validated profile at record.base_revision ({} for a create or a tombstone base), or null when not held (a create is always checked against {}). For each field of next: prev holds the key with an equal value (cjson of value) -> the field MUST be byte-identical to prev (same by, at, src); otherwise by MUST equal record.author and at MUST equal record.ts. A breaking field is dropped (dropped, key order); with prev null every field is kept. origins are transitive: a kept field shows its src only when by = self_device_id and prev was held (or the record is a create) and either the field is new or changed and record.author = self_device_id, or the field is unchanged and prev_origins[key] equals its src (prev_origins: the origins this check returned when the device accepted prev); every other field, and every field when prev is null, is "sync". cases MUST yield expect exactly. chains replay consecutive revisions as one device (self_device_id) sees them: step 0 uses start.prev and start.prev_origins; each later step uses the previous step expect.profile and expect.origins; every step MUST yield its expect exactly. carry_forward: carryForwardMeta(meta) drops kind, item_ids, policy, profile and any key that, lowercased with "_", "-" and "." removed, equals a profile key with "_" removed; it MUST yield expect. Payload meta keys are already [a-z0-9_]+ (cjson), so in practice the fold catches spellings such as whentouse and usagehosts; the "-" and "." folds are defensive.
